node.statement: Under the hypotheses of node 1, set p=row_i(F), S={a in {1,...,n}: p_a>0}, and give S the directed edges a->b exactly when f_ab>0. Then S is nonempty and closed under F, the restriction G=(f_ab)_{a,b in S} is row-stochastic, and the directed graph of G is strongly connected.
